(Establishment and

Expenditure)
column7:
Reasons for non-
utilisation of the entire
provision have not been
intimated (July 2025).

Augmentation in
provision of ₹78.50 lakh
was attributed to need of
additional amounts in
salary, subsistence
allowance, house rent
allowance, transport
allowance, medical
allowance, other
allowance, travelling
allowance, office
expenses, electricity
charges, rented tax and
contract services. Final
saving of ₹245.20 lakh is
understated by ₹15.89
lakh due to clearance of
OB suspense related to
previous years. Reasons
for actual final saving of
₹261.09 lakh have not
been intimated (July
2025).
